newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brinker Intl rating raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brinker Intl rating raised.

text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co said its analyst Andrew Barish raised his rating on shares of Brinker International Inc to buy from long-term attractive.
-- In a statement, the investment research firm said Barish based his upgrade on the restaurant operator/franchisor's valuation, positive sales trends, strong unit growth and earnings acceleration.
-- Barish believes the company will earn $0.93/shr in 1997 and $1.12/shr in 1998.
